shared_elements: curved arc or dome-like line spanning the field
incised outline drawing with fine linear interior detail
tall plume/feather-like or vegetal fan motifs
justification: Both surfaces show the same repertoire of finely incised outline profile figures accompanied by dense fields of small pictographic signs, and both include a broad curved arc with a disc set beneath or within it, a fairly specific shared convention rather than a generic one. The biggest difference in depicted content is that B presents a complete, strictly ordered scheme (arched lunette over a figural register over many ruled lines of text) whereas A shows only a crowded cluster of plumed/fan-like forms and figures with no visible register ordering.
